title: How could this even be enforced?
author: Frosty-Cockroach-807
selftext:
This is from a recently purchased asset pack on the Unity Asset Store.

Firstly, I think it's absolutely within the rights of the creator of an asset pack to prohibit using the assets to train models.

But I'm honestly wondering how this could even be enforced? How could the creator of these assets ever know  if OpenAI or Anthropic included these assets in their training data anyway?

To me this is a huge issue with this technology. It's borderline illegal how they are trained but completely unenforceable.
